name.dum: Dat hantvingherlijn oft vanden blickenden steene

description.dum: Kort traktaat over de drie levens van de goede, de innige en de schouwende mens, naar Apc 2,17: de blinkende steen met de nieuwe naam. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1868).
description.en-US: A short treatise on the good, the interior and the contemplative man, from Rev 2:17, the bright stone bearing a new name. The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1868).
description.pt-BR: Breve tratado sobre o homem bom, o homem interior e o contemplativo, a partir de Ap 2,17: a pedra brilhante com o nome novo. Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1868).

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 6: Dit is dat hantvingherlijn oft vanden blickenden steene. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1868).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.
